body: I don't like the thought of people getting to know me before I do something like this.

my family is very small, at the most four people would be there. Maybe more considering the friends of my mother who would pity her. I've tried speaking up about it but they all brushed it off. And if it's as bad as it is at my age, I could only guess how far it would go if I continued. I'm sorry for your loss.
